details.headline: Building a Scalable Marketplace with Optimized Search
details.problem: Local student artists lacked a dedicated platform to sell their work, and potential buyers couldn't easily search for local art. The technical challenge was building a scalable platform with fast, relevant search.
details.solution: As Frontend Lead, I directed the UI development using React.js and Redux for robust state management. For the backend, I architected the search functionality using Java Spring integrated with Elasticsearch, focusing on optimizing indexing strategies, custom analyzers, and mappings.

impact.text: Reduction in search latency (from 800ms to 400ms using Elasticsearch custom analyzers and field boosting)
Improvement in frontend render time via Redux optimization (reduced initial load from 3.2s to 2.2s)
Successful launch of the Minimum Viable Product with 200+ active users in first month

techHighlight.title: Code Spotlight: Elasticsearch Optimized Query DSL

points.title: Bool Query (must/filter)
points.description: Combines scoring queries ('must') with non-scoring queries ('filter'). Filters are faster and cacheable, improving overall performance.

points.title: Multi-match & Field Boosting (^3)
points.description: Searches across multiple fields while giving higher relevance scores (boosted by 3x) to matches in the 'title' field.

points.title: Fuzziness: AUTO
points.description: Improves user experience by allowing minor typos in the search term without sacrificing performance.

points.title: Aggregations (aggs)
points.description: Efficiently calculates summary data (like category counts for faceted search) alongside the main query results.
